description.la: In Marci evangelium expositio libris quattuor, ad Accam.
description.en-US: Bede's four-book exposition of the Gospel of Mark, drawn from Jerome, Augustine, Ambrose and Gregory, dedicated to Bishop Acca. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: A exposição de Beda ao Evangelho de Marcos, em quatro livros, colhida em Jerônimo, Agostinho, Ambrósio e Gregório, dedicada ao bispo Acca.

sources.edition: In Evangelium S. Marci Beda on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
